name: Racial tech: Gauntling
notes: Gauntling arsenal (docs/waves/racial_tech_1.md): 3 ship weapons, 3 components and 2 hand weapons, each with a strong pro and a con the race's own traits cancel. Sold in Gantry Rusthold (its region's stock in data/regions/gauntling_scrapyards.json). The hand weapons have no art yet: their `art` ids (art/items/<id>.png) are the ids of the entries.
